version.description: update filter on productStrategies to use location in remote trx query data in place of request raw data to prevent errrors in mass update requests

data.transform:
return `
SELECT 
  t.billingaddress,
  t.currency,
  t.duedate,
  t.entity,
  t.id,
  t.memo,
  t.number,
  t.ordreceived,
  t.shipdate,
  t.shippingaddress,
  t.status,
  t.trandate,
  t.tranid,
  t.type,
  t.void,
  t.custbodyfuuz_record_status,
  t.custbodyfuuz_recordid,
  t.custbodymes_last_updatedat,
  t.custbodymes_scoped,
  l.actualshipdate,
  l.foreignamount,
  l.expectedreceiptdate,
  l.expectedshipdate,
  l.id lineid,
  l.isbillable,
  l.isclosed,
  l.isfullyshipped,
  l.item,
  l.linesequencenumber,
  l.location,
  l.mainline,
  l.memo linememo,
  l.quantity,
  l.rate,
  l.quantityshiprecv,
  l.uniquekey,
  l.units,
  l.subsidiary,
  l.taxline,
  i.itemtype
FROM 
  transaction t
LEFT JOIN transactionline l 
  ON t.id=l.transaction 
LEFT JOIN item i
  ON i.id=l.item
WHERE
  t.id = ${$state.context.REQUEST.DATA.id}
  AND
  l.taxline='F'

`

data.responseTransform: "Enable Netsuite in the MES Application Configuration to use this functionality"
